subject: Startups
title: Viral Coefficient
description: A short lesson to help you apply Viral Coefficient.

hook.text: What if every user brings in more than one new user? That's a viral coefficient above 1.0—exponential growth.

buildup.text: The viral coefficient measures how many new users each existing user generates through invites or sharing.

discovery.text: Hotmail grew by adding 'Get your free email' to every outgoing email. Viral coefficient went through the roof.

twist.text: A coefficient of 0.9 and 1.1 look similar but behave fully differently. Below 1.0, growth fizzles. Above, it explodes.

climax.text: True virality is rare. Most 'viral' products are actually driven by paid marketing disguised as organic spread.

punchline.text: Above 1.0, growth feeds itself. Below, you're pushing uphill.

quiz.question: What does a viral coefficient above 1.0 mean?
options: Each user brings in more than one new user on average
